Booty Focus Workouts

Example structure for members who want more glute-focused training.

Day 1 — Glutes Heavy

  • Hip Thrust — 4x10
  • Bulgarian Split Squat — 3x12
  • Romanian Deadlift — 3x10
  • Glute Bridge Hold — 3x30 sec

Day 3 — Glutes Volume

  • Kickbacks — 4x12
  • Walking Lunges — 3x20
  • Step-ups — 3x12
  • Band Abductions — 3x20
